question.text: Post the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 amendment (effective 1 October 2024), the STT rate on the SALE of futures in securities is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 increased STT on sale of futures in securities from 0.0125% to 0.02% with effect from 1 October 2024. Correspondingly STT on sale of options in securities was hiked from 0.0625% to 0.1%. **The Trap:** 0.0125% is the pre-Oct-2024 rate. 0.1% is the new options rate. 0.2% is the unlisted-shares-OFS rate. Candidates confused between futures vs options. **Cross-Exam Context:** VIII (Equity Derivatives) tests STT on derivatives extensively. XIX-E drills the new 2024 rates for Cat III F&O strategies. XXI-B mentions STT as a frictional cost. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Sahyadri's high-turnover stat-arb strategies now eat 60% more STT on futures sales after Oct 2024 (0.0125 → 0.02). Re-benchmark each strategy's break-even alpha against the new STT; strategies with <1% gross alpha per cycle may be uneconomical post-hike.
